name: agz-example-issue-tracker
description: Search a GitHub-style issues API from the agent, with a panel that lists the results.

agzPlugin.name: Issue Tracker
agzPlugin.description: Search a GitHub-style issues API from the agent, with a panel that lists the results.

description.en: The issues endpoint, for example https://api.github.com/repos/OWNER/REPO/issues. Do not put credentials in the URL.
description.tr: Sorunlar uç noktası, örneğin https://api.github.com/repos/OWNER/REPO/issues. Adrese kimlik bilgisi yazmayın.

description.en: Sent as a bearer token. Leave it empty for a public repository.
description.tr: Taşıyıcı anahtar olarak gönderilir. Herkese açık bir depo için boş bırakın.
